# DOM Director

> A framework-neutral, data-only cinematic walkthrough engine for intentional live-DOM surfaces, with optional React bindings. Implementation candidate 0.1.0-rc.0; packages are private and not published to npm.

## Implemented entry points

- [README and quick start](README.md)

- [Core TypeScript declarations](packages/core/src/index.d.ts)
- [React lifecycle integration](packages/react/README.md)
- [Canonical tour schema](schemas/tour.schema.json)
- [Agent command schema](schemas/agent-command.schema.json)
- [Canonical Orbit walkthrough](site/orbit.tour.json)
- [Agent consumer](site/agent.mjs)
- [Release evidence and limitations](docs/release-candidate.md)
- [Agent working agreement](AGENTS.md)

## Trust boundaries

Scripts cannot contain executable callbacks or grant host permissions. Target IDs resolve through host-owned registries. Missing targets fail explicitly. Simulated input is never consent. Visual seeking does not execute actions. Try requires an isolated fixture. Checkpoints are same-run visual resume only. The bridge is in-process, bounded JSON, not an authenticated remote/MCP transport. No telemetry, live model, recording or persistence is enabled by default.

Use the implemented declarations and executable tests for available behavior. Earlier design chapters describe a broader roadmap; do not treat optional features as shipped.
